name: @timetracker/extension
description: Time Tracker MV3 Chrome extension (popup, badge service worker, content script).

scripts.build: vite build && cp manifest.json dist/ && cp -r icons dist/
scripts.zip: pnpm build && cd dist && zip -qr -X ../timetracker-extension.zip . -x '.*' && echo 'Wrote apps/extension/timetracker-extension.zip (upload this to the Chrome Web Store)'
scripts.ext:id: openssl rsa -in .keys/extension.pem -pubout -outform DER 2>/dev/null | openssl dgst -sha256 -binary | xxd -p -c 32 | head -c 32 | tr '0-9a-f' 'a-p'; echo
